metadata.title: Lomustine 130 mg/m² Therapy
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00805 Version 2. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

treatment.schedule_summary: Lomustine 130 mg/m² orally on Day 1 every 6 weeks (maximum 280 mg).

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

pulmonary_symptoms_or_concern.label: New pulmonary symptoms or concern for lomustine-associated pulmonary toxicity

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild or asymptomatic; observation only and intervention generally not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; minimal, local or non-invasive intervention may be indicated; may limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant but not immediately life-threatening; hospital care may be indicated; limits self-care activities of daily living.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event and assess severity, intervention required and functional impact.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed; omitted clinical domains remain unassessed.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold the affected treatment component and follow the current NCCP reassessment pathway.
output_templates.consultant_review: Consultant review is required before treatment.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Apply the encoded dose modification after recovery and consultant/pharmacy confirmation.

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Use the most restrictive applicable action.

action.message: Delay until recovery to baseline; for clinically relevant toxicity reduce lomustine by 50%, with later full-dose resumption only if the event does not recur for 42 days.

action.message: Delay lomustine until ANC is at least 1.0 ×10⁹/L and platelets are at least 100 ×10⁹/L; consider dose reduction.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current NCCP regimen emetogenic classification; regimen phase/component and local policy must be considered.
other_supportive_care: Contraception during treatment and for 6 months after lomustine.
Monitor for delayed myelosuppression and pulmonary toxicity.
